source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer; OCR corrected against the page images. No year and no time allowance are printed; examYear 2025 is taken from the file name (...-070325-2025) and the icseboard.org folder. Section A (40 marks) is compulsory; Section B has six questions (8 marks each) of which any five are to be attempted, so the listed marks add up to 88, not 80. Both sections number their questions 1-6, so question numbers are stored as A1-A6 and B1-B6. Per-item marks in Section A are the group total divided by the number of items (Question 5: [6] for three terms; Question 6: [8] for four items). Handwritten page tallies (23, 24) and the icseboard.org watermark are ignored. The class 6 chapter list has no simple-machines chapter: machine questions that are about load/effort/force are mapped to 'force', the rest have chapter null.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
